rules.text: Eligible products may be returned within 60 days of receipt for a refund or exchange.
rules.quote: Eligible products may be returned within 60 days of receipt for a refund or exchange.

rules.text: During severe weather or natural disasters, sales of generators, chainsaws and water pumps may be designated as final and not returnable.
rules.quote: During the threat or occurrence of a severe weather event or natural disaster, sales of generators, chainsaws and water pumps may be designated as final.

rules.text: Gas and diesel-powered products cannot be returned after they have been fueled or oiled.
rules.quote: Gas and diesel-powered products cannot be returned to Northern Tool after they have been fueled or oiled.

rules.text: Custom and built-to-order products are nonreturnable.
rules.quote: Custom and built-to-order products are nonreturnable.

rules.text: NorTrac equipment, surface cleaners, gang reels, winches, reconditioned forklifts, books, DVDs, CDs, videos, blueprints, clearance items and electronic auction items are nonreturnable.
rules.quote: NorTrac equipment, surface cleaners, gang reels, winches, reconditioned forklifts, books, DVDs, CDs, videos, blueprints, clearance items and electronic auction items are nonreturnable.

rules.text: A restocking fee of up to 15% may apply to products that are not defective or are returned used, opened, incomplete or without original packaging.
rules.quote: A restocking fee of up to 15% may apply to products that are not defective or are returned used, opened, incomplete or without their original packaging.

rules.text: Factory-shipped products may be subject to a restocking fee of up to 15% and require manufacturer approval before return.
rules.quote: Factory-shipped products require approval from the manufacturer before they can be returned and should not be returned directly to Northern Tool. These products may also be subject to a restocking fee of up to 15%.

rules.text: Returns require a packing slip, order number, or return authorization number to expedite the return process.
rules.quote: To expedite your return at the store, please bring your packing slip, order number, or return authorization number along with your products for return.

rules.text: Processing a return via shipment will take 2-4 weeks.
rules.quote: Processing your return via shipment will take 2-4 weeks.

rules.text: Refunds are for the cost of the products only.
rules.quote: Refunds are for the cost of the products only.
